response.sql: WITH product_metrics AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_qty, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as order_item_count, (COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items)) as share_of_order_items FROM Products p INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), type_averages AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_qty) as avg_quantity_by_type, AVG(order_item_count) as avg_order_item_count_by_type, AVG(share_of_order_items) as avg_share_by_type FROM product_metrics GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity_by_type) as final_avg_quantity, AVG(avg_order_item_count_by_type) as final_avg_order_item_count, AVG(avg_share_by_type) as final_avg_share FROM type_averages
